model.construction: OPA total held fixed where there is a building: land = min(S5, total), building = total - land. On bare lots the cap is lifted and land = S5. On lots larger than the land sales can test, bare or built, S5 is first divided by its held-out ratio to sale price in the lot's size band; bare tracts judged use-restricted keep OPA's value.

large_tract_rule.rule: S5's own value (rate x lot area, uncapped) divided by S5's held-out median ratio to price in the lot's size band beyond the support edge; the re-split then caps it at the parcel's total where there is a building

keep_opa.rule: bare tracts beyond the edge judged use-restricted, or not a bare tract, keep OPA's value

opa_large_vacant_ratio_basis.basis: median of TY2026 OPA land / time-adjusted sale price on philly_open_avmkit's held-out still-vacant (W1) land sales beyond the support edge (philly_open_avmkit/notebooks/pipeline/data/us-pa-philadelphia/out/land/holdout_predictions.csv); its own figure is the same statistic on its OPA roll (TY2027)

model.homestead_rule: in proportion to land and building value
model.relief_rule: long-running non-abatement relief kept, carried in dollars, and divided between land and building value share

worked_example.basis: median land and median building value of taxable single-family homes

basis.rule: the review's hand judgements (basis_source 'hand') on bare tracts beyond the edge: an OPA-basis tract keeps this roll's OPA value, an S5-relevelled tract takes this export's S5 divided by the review's factor by band and use class (land_value_surface / s5_relevelled); every other bare tract beyond the edge carried at OPA. Built parcels keep the headline's land. The review's own dollars are on OPA's TY2027 roll, philly_open_avmkit's, and are not imported
basis.status: a sensitivity: the headline relevels every bare tract beyond the edge by S5's band factor and keeps OPA's value only on the tracts the review judged use-restricted

basis.taxable: some taxable land or building value on the TY2026 roll

basis.homes: taxable 1-4-unit homes with a bill today
basis.homestead: OPA records a Homestead Exemption and some value is exempt in the TY2026 assessment
basis.owner_occupied: homestead, or an individual owner whose mailing address is the home (philadelphia_abatement_phase_in.owner_occupied)
basis.typical_home: median land $48,746 and median building $187,212 (gross, before the exemption) of homestead-only single-family homes; not the same house as the median bill
caveats: formerly abated homes (the abatement bars the homestead) are not granted it once it expires
every order but building_first needs 53 Pa.C.S. Sec. 8583(c) amended
rates are re-solved revenue-neutral under each order
`transition` is computed at the headline order only

building_first.rule: off the building first, remainder off land (53 Pa.C.S. Sec. 8583(c), current law)

land_first.rule: off land first, remainder off the building

value_share.rule: in proportion to land and building value

tax_share.rule: in proportion to each line's share of the tax (land weighted 4:1)

basis.sector: the 'commercial/mixed/other' property group, the flyer's 'Commercial' bar
basis.building_type: OPA building_code_description, grouped by lvt.philadelphia.commercial_building_type (parking by building_code)
basis.attributes: analysis/ownership/philadelphia/opa_attributes.parquet, OPA's current properties table (file dated 2026-08-18); the cross-table omits cells under 10 parcels
basis.caveat: S5 is fitted on small-lot land sales and values expensive land relatively low, so the cuts to towers and the increases on large lots are the model's least reliable figures

typical_rowhouse.basis: median gross land and median gross building of 210,208 homestead-only single-family homes

basis.homes: taxable 1-4-unit homes with a bill today

basis.surface: FHFA tract land share of single-family property value, applied to each single-family house's own total (condominium units keep S5); S5 everywhere else (cities/philadelphia/data/fhfa_land_share_by_tract.csv)

inc_q.compare: poorest minus richest, aggregate % change of homes

min_q.compare: most non-white minus whitest, aggregate % change of homes

s5_tract_smoothed.basis: S5's value-weighted land share of the same single-family homes' totals, one share per 2020 tract, applied to each matched home's own total; S5 everywhere else. FHFA's form with S5's land, so fhfa_over_tract_smoothed compares the two land estimates and nothing else

basis.surface: OPA's own land values (taxable plus exempt land) on every parcel

inc_q.compare: poorest minus richest, aggregate % change of homes

min_q.compare: most non-white minus whitest, aggregate % change of homes

basis.status: sensitivities of the headline to the land values used; none changes the headline construction or a printed figure
basis.inputs: philly_open_avmkit/notebooks/pipeline/data/us-pa-philadelphia/out/land, philly_open_avmkit's land outputs; mechanisms in its CLAUDE.md and audits/*2026-09-29.md

basis.rule: built parcels beyond the edge take S5's own extrapolated value, not relevelled, capped at the parcel's total; bare lots as the headline
basis.status: a sensitivity: how much of the headline the relevel of built parcels carries

basis.rule: OPA's own land divided by 0.945, its median ratio to price on held-out still-vacant land sales beyond the edge (on this roll), on built parcels (capped at the total) and bare lots beyond the edge alike
basis.status: a sensitivity: the least dispersed estimator on the held-out sales beyond the edge, not significantly, and derived from the assessor's own figure

basis.rule: as the headline, except parcels priced from S5's citywide comparable pool (S5 equal to its use-class-blind form) take the edge-to-acre factor in both bands; class-pool parcels keep their band's
basis.status: a sensitivity: 40 of the 50 acre-plus sales behind the acre-plus factor are industrial, and the class pools' flat size elasticity is the over-valuation's mechanism

basis.construction: each surface's $/sqft x the export's lot area where the parcel is in philly_open_avmkit's universe (for s0_opa, this roll's own OPA land there), the headline's land elsewhere; beyond the support edge each surface divided by its own held-out median ratio in the lot's size band where it has 25 or more held-out sales there (relevel_beyond_edge says which); the headline's within-total re-split, bare-lot rule, use-restricted tracts, homestead order and revenue-neutral solve
basis.held_out_tilt: median held-out ratio (surface / land sale price) in the low fifth over the high fifth, block-group fifths, held-out folds; interval resamples gma2 market areas. Above 1, the surface over-values the poorer or more non-white fifth's land relative to the other's
basis.s5_row: rebuilt from the surface file; must reproduce the headline

s0_opa.label: S0 OPA (this model's TY2026 OPA land, not relevelled)

held_out_tilt.roll: OPA's TY2027 land, philly_open_avmkit's roll; the bills in this row use TY2026

basis.sales_filter: valid_for_ratio_study, not vacant, sold 2024-01-01 or later, a billed home here
basis.ratio: this model's TY2026 gross total / time-adjusted sale price
basis.relevel: each billed home's total divided by its fifth's median ratio, rescaled so homes' total value is unchanged; homestead-only homes keep their exemption dollars, other relief scales; S5 land and every other parcel unchanged

basis.status: a sensitivity: S5's dollar level is low on last year's land sales because philly_open_avmkit's time index under-states land appreciation; the registered swap to a repeat-sales index failed, so the headline keeps S5 as certified
basis.rule: S5-based land multiplied by each reading's scale, built as the headline builds its land: the relevel beyond the edge unchanged, the re-split's cap at each built parcel's total, use-restricted tracts left at OPA's value

scale.reading: the production schedule's temporal median ratio to last year's raw land sales
the same, over S5's own random-fold level on still-vacant lots; post hoc in that test

basis.model: per parcel, log(S5 / true land) ~ Normal(log median held-out ratio, 1.4826 x MAD) of the parcel's bin of distance to the nearest witness; the witness bins are by distance to the nearest witness in the other folds, as S5 saw it when it priced that witness. Berkson form (the truth scattered around S5, which spreads land shares and shifts the centre of the draws away from the headline); independent across parcels, so a shock shared by a neighbourhood is not modelled here (held_out_equity tests that); S5's own values only, perturbed before the re-split's cap and after the relevel beyond the support edge; everything else is the headline's
basis.band: per metric: the headline and every model's 5th to 95th percentile of draws, low to high

basis.read: tilt = median held-out ratio in the low fifth over the high fifth; 1 is no tilt
basis.opa_roll: philly_open_avmkit's OPA figures (its S0 OPA surface, and the OPA-total terms of the reconciliation) are on OPA's TY2027 roll; this model's bills, and land_robustness.opa_tilt_relevel, are on TY2026

homes_dollar_range.basis: homes' aggregate change in $M (negative: homes pay less in total); the headline is S5, relevelled beyond the support edge by its held-out error in the lot's size band, with use-restricted bare tracts at OPA

on_level_range.basis: the headline, OPA relevelled on every lot beyond the edge, the pool-aware relevel, and every S5 error model's 5th to 95th percentile

least_negative.axis: S5's own error (5th to 95th percentile of draws)
